quiz.name: Tutorial 8B - Frobenius Methods
quiz.intro:
SATURDAY 10, MAY 2025

TUTORIAL 8B IS READY. Spare your time to learn Power Series and Frobenius Methods as well as earning points for the course work. This tutorial will remain open until the end of semester.
